Warn when a propensity score is numerically 0 or 1

Source: R/ps-score.R
dot-warn_saturated_score.Rd

A finite, converged logistic fit can still give a patient with an extreme covariate value a probability within 10 * .Machine$double.eps of 0 or 1, the threshold at which glm.fit() warns. stats::glm() caps the linear predictor there, so the logit is near +/-36 rather than infinite, but the value reflects the cap, not the model, and an inverse-probability weight on the wrong side of it is of order 1e15. Name those patients when the score is made, rather than leave it to a later step.

Usage

.warn_saturated_score(p, score_col, logit_col, id = NULL)

Arguments

p

Propensity scores.

score_col, logit_col

Column names, for the message.

id

Patient identifiers, or NULL for row numbers.

Value

Invisible NULL.
